title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with edit permission for the container label on a pending…
description: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with edit permission on the container label of a pending approval can exploit a vulnerability in the Approval details REST API. This flaw allows the user to read an external-prompt capability without verifying approval ownership, enabling them to view prompt content, alter the pending approval decision, and modify action parameters.
